statements.status_notes: Upstream fixed CVE-2026-25210 (missing integer overflow check on the tag buffer reallocation in doContent) in Expat 2.7.4 (libexpat PR #1075, commits 7ddea35, 8855346 and 9c2d990; https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1075). Debian fixed it for trixie in 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6404-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-25210). The DHI Alpine 3.23 expat package is built from Alpine's aports, whose expat APKBUILD lists this CVE as fixed in 2.7.4-r0 (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/expat/APKBUILD). 2.7.4-r0 is the first DHI Alpine 3.23 build of Expat 2.7.4; the only earlier published build, 2.7.3-r0, predates the fix.

Upstream fixed CVE-2026-25210 (missing integer overflow check on the tag buffer reallocation in doContent) in Expat 2.7.4 (libexpat PR #1075, commits 7ddea35, 8855346 and 9c2d990; https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1075). Debian fixed it for trixie in 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6404-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-25210). The DHI Debian 13 expat packages built from 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 and every later Debian revision ship upstream Expat 2.8.2 or newer, which contains the fix; the range's fixed version is the lowest such build published, on amd64 and arm64. The older builds of upstream 2.7.1 sort below that version and stay on the affected side of the range.
